name: memoQ
tagline: memoQ is a computer-assisted translation tool and translation management system used by professional translators, language service providers, and in-house localization teams. It combines translation memory, terminology management, and AI-assisted suggestions to speed up repetitive work without losing consistency. It handles XLIFF, DOCX, HTML, software strings, and other complex formats natively.
